ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level contrast ratio; visual field is approximately 94% low-intensity (dark-grey/black) and 6% high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark pigment background with high-contrast white focal points (circular rings and linear marks) distributed irregularly; higher density of light pixels noted on the mid-lobes and along the distal-lateral margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped notch with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations characterized by jagged peaks and valleys along the entire trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric bi-lobed structure showing a concave sweep from the median notch transitioning into a broad convex curve toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast white annular rings (3-12 pixel diameter) distributed across both lobes, concentrated in the central-ventral region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions (scratches) varying in length, with prominent horizontal rake-marks on the center-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of highly textured, off-white clusters (calcified organisms) localized specifically on the distal-most tips of both fluke lobes.
